entries.274751a967efa170: A battery manufacturer that makes lead-acid batteries for automobiles, industrial batteries, and automotive lithium-ion batteries, and sells them worldwide.
entries.3329bdb0e00c4139: This business manufactures and sells industrial batteries and power supply equipment used in buildings, factories, telecommunications, railways and others. It also handles emergency power supplies that operate during power outages, energy storage systems that store electricity, and lighting equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥124,093 million, up 9.7% from the previous year, due to higher demand for lithium-ion batteries for power storage and a large order received for emergency power supply equipment, among other factors.

entries.7b7d1662b27adc75: This business manufactures and sells lead-acid batteries for automobiles and motorcycles in Japan. It is carried out by the Automotive Battery Division of GS Yuasa Co., Ltd., GS Yuasa Battery Co., Ltd., GS Yuasa Energy Co., Ltd., and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥108,006 million, up 6.0% from the previous year, owing to higher sales volumes and measures to revise selling prices.
entries.8ff1d638e923d7bd: This business is not included in the four reportable segments and includes the Specialty Battery Business and others. It handles battery manufacturing equipment, environment-related equipment, batteries for mobile communications, lithium-ion batteries for aerospace use, and others, and is carried out by GS Yuasa Technology Co., Ltd., GS Yuasa Membrane Co., Ltd., and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥22,454 million, up 0.2% from the previous year, due to higher sales volumes of lithium-ion batteries for space use, among other factors.

entries.d4187bf221ed9912: A business that manufactures and sells lithium-ion batteries for installation in automobiles. It is handled by Blue Energy Co., Ltd. and GS Yuasa Hungary in Hungary, while Honda GS Yuasa EV Battery R&D Co., Ltd., a joint venture with Honda Motor Co., Ltd., is an equity-method affiliate. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥89,928 million, up 8.6% from the previous fiscal year owing to higher sales volumes for hybrid vehicles and plug-in hybrid vehicles.

entries.f49fd74f666bfe0b: This business manufactures and sells lead-acid batteries for automobiles and motorcycles overseas, and is the company's largest segment by revenue. Subsidiaries in Taiwan, the United Kingdom, the United States, Australia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam and others handle it. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥264,511 million, up 1.7% from the previous year, as sales volumes rose in Southeast Asia and Europe.
